draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Trichy! The city sits almost at the geographic centre of Tamil Nadu, and its recorded history goes all the way back to Chola rule in the 3rd century BC.
draft.hungryLine: Trichy does a solid South Indian breakfast, and it's worth chasing with a glass of nanari sarbat on a hot afternoon.

moodReplies.show-me-around: St. Mary's Cathedral is just a 7 min walk, and the Basilica of the Holy Redeemer is about 19 minutes away. For the big view, head to the Rockfort Temple, 5 km north of the railway junction.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take a short drive out to Mukkombu, about 15 km from Trichy Junction, where the Kaveri country starts to open up.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Kallanai, the dam near Trichy, is around 2,000 years old and was built by Karikala Cholan.

spots.name: St. Mary's Cathedral
spots.detail: 7 min walk · Gothic and Romanesque cathedral of the 'Mother of Good Health', finished in 1841

spots.name: Basilica of the Holy Redeemer
spots.detail: 19 min walk · One of ten minor basilicas in Tamil Nadu, with roots in the 1600s Madurai Mission

spots.name: Rockfort Temple
spots.detail: Short ride · 5 km north of the junction, with the Thayumaanavar and Uchchi pillayar temples

tips.title: Expect dry heat.
tips.body: Trichy's climate is extremely hot, though the humidity is low, so carry water and go out early.

tips.title: Ride the city buses.
tips.body: The bus network is very well developed and gets you to most of the city cheaply, including bus #1 to the Rockfort.

story.title: Chola beginnings
story.body: Trichy's recorded history starts under the Cholas. Karikala Cholan's Kallanai dam nearby is around 2,000 years old.

story.title: Many rulers
story.body: The city passed through the Mutharayars, Pallavas, Pandyas, the Vijayanagar Empire and the Nayaks. Later it went to the Carnatic state and the British.

story.title: The Madurai Mission
story.body: Jesuit missionaries made the first conversions around Tiruchirappalli in 1616. The Basilica of the Holy Redeemer traces its story back to this time.

story.title: Siege of Trichinopoly
story.body: After a six-month siege, Murari Rao surrendered the city to the Nizam on 29 August 1743. It ended Maratha dominance over the Carnatic.

story.title: Tamil Nadu's centre
story.body: With 916,857 people in 2011, Trichy is the state's fourth largest urban area. Srirangam island, formed where the Kaveri splits, is now part of the city.

food.name: Sri Saraswathi Cafe
food.detail: Traditional South Indian food since 1964, opposite the Railway Junction

food.name: Khurunji
food.detail: Pure veg restaurant at Hotel Guru, go for the fresh lunch meals

food.name: Birmanda Sarbat Stall
food.detail: Ayurvedic nanari sarbat, served in the city for over three decades
